list: the official 55 trophies, as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them
note: GTA VI is unreleased at the time of writing. Names and descriptions are the official text; every guide is written in our own words and says plainly where a step goes beyond the description.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: From the description: this is the Platinum, and it unlocks when you have earned the other 54 trophies — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in this guide (story, side strands, collectibles, activities, then 100% completion) and it pops with the last trophy you earn. Unconfirmed: any time estimate for the Platinum; fan guides guess around 200 hours, which is a guess, not a fact.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The Platinum unlocks automatically with the last one.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: From the description: complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks by playing the story from the start — it cannot be missed. Unconfirmed: anything about what happens inside the mission beyond its name, which the description does not say.
steps: Start the story and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.

steps: Play the main story missions through the end of Chapter 1.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: From the description: reach 100% completion — this is the second gold trophy and the last big grind before the Platinum. The description does not list what 100% counts, so treat any checklist of its contents as unconfirmed until the game's own 100% screen says so; one fan guide (GTA Vice City Hub) reports a 35-task checklist, which is unconfirmed here. Plan it last, after the story, side strands, collectibles and activities are done.
steps: Finish the story, side strands, collectibles and activities.
Open the game's 100% completion screen and clear whatever it still lists.
The trophy pops at 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: From the description: complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's stunt jumps and driving feats, and the count is tracked for you — chip away at them in free roam between story missions rather than leaving all 250 for the end. Unconfirmed: exactly which moves count as a stunt and whether every stunt jump counts once or can be repeated — the description gives only the total.
steps: Do stunt jumps and driving stunts in free roam; the game counts them toward 250.
Use ramps and jumps you pass while doing other trophies, so the count builds on its own.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: From the description: try each type of activity once. This is a taster trophy — one go at every activity the game offers is enough, no wins or high scores needed. Unconfirmed: how many activity types there are; the kit's starter lists 9, but the description itself gives no number, so check the in-game activities menu and try each entry on it once.
steps: Open the in-game activities list and play one round of each type.
The trophy pops when every type has been tried once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: From the description: earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — the kit's starter records the count as 42. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: each challenge needs a gold-medal score, so expect to replay the harder ones. Unconfirmed: where each range is and what each challenge's gold threshold is — the description gives only the requirement.
steps: Find a Shooting Range and work through its challenges.
Replay any challenge until you earn its gold medal; all 42 must be gold.

steps: Find each Top Fun Drone Race location.
Win the race at every one of the 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps: Win races one at a time, each a different race.
Keep count toward 20 different wins; repeats of a won race add nothing.

Play it through to completion.

Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, as a precaution.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: From the description: complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is finished when you hold every card in it, and you need three full sets. steps: Collect cards across Leonida.
Finish all the cards of one set, then two more sets — 3 complete sets in total.

trophies.guide: From the description: use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo/tagging activity — do it at 100 different spots, and the count is tracked for you. Fold it into exploring all 52 areas so the two trophies progress together. Unconfirmed: what WAiNK It looks like in play and whether any location can be repeated — the description gives only the total.

Reach 100 different locations.

trophies.guide: From the description: complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's checklist goals across activities and the open world — finish any 50 of them and the trophy pops. steps: Open the in-game challenges list.
Complete 50 challenges of any kind.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: From the description: with your partner beside you, reach a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it and escape. Both parts matter — the partner must be with you, and you must escape clean, not get caught or killed. Do it in free roam when both characters are together, and break line of sight until the stars clear.
steps: Play with your partner alongside you.
Raise your Wanted Level to 4 stars.
Escape until the Wanted Level clears.
trophies.whenMissed: One attempt at a time: getting caught or killed ends the attempt, so retry in free roam until you escape clean.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: From the description: with your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level. The tricky part is the second half — you must keep the heat on through all three robberies, so plan a route of three nearby shops, move fast between them, and do not let the Wanted Level drop to zero before the third. If it clears, the chain breaks and you start over.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first, then the second, then the third — back-to-back.
Keep a Wanted Level active through all three robberies.
trophies.whenMissed: The chain breaks if your Wanted Level clears before the third shop — retry the whole run of three.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: From the description: discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter new vehicles and the game logs each new one — variety matters, not repeats of the same model. Work through traffic, parked cars and mission vehicles across Leonida until the count hits 100.
steps: Enter or drive vehicles you have not discovered before.
Keep going until 100 different vehicles are discovered.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: From the description: take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slowed-aim mode — the whole thing has to happen inside one activation, so set it up where five enemies are close together, trigger it, and drop all five before it ends. If you run out of targets mid-use, the attempt fails and you try again.
steps: Find a spot with at least 5 enemies close together.
Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 of them before it ends.
trophies.whenMissed: One activation only: if fewer than 5 go down before Combat Focus ends, retry the attempt.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: From the description: make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the Vice City International Airport. In plain terms: get a plane off the ground at the airport without following the normal route. Unconfirmed: exactly what counts as unscheduled — a stolen plane, a runway takeoff under pursuit, or a specific stunt — the description does not say, so try a plane takeoff at VCIA in free roam and watch for the pop.
steps: Go to VCIA in free roam.
Take a plane and make an unscheduled departure — get airborne from the airport.
trophies.whenMissed: A single airport moment: if the attempt is interrupted, try again in free roam.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: From the description — which is only the line “Kinda hot in these Rhinos”: this is about the Rhino tank, and the joke is that it gets hot inside one. The description does not spell out the action, so this guide does not invent one: the reasonable reading is to get into a Rhino tank and use it, and the exact trigger is unconfirmed until players test it after release.
steps: Find a Rhino tank and get inside it.
Use the tank until the trophy pops; the exact trigger is unconfirmed.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: From the description: rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole requirement — no alarm, no witness raising the alarm, no detection at any point in the robbery. Plan it quietly, move slowly, and if you are spotted, the attempt is over: leave and try the robbery again.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and enter without drawing attention.
Rob it from start to finish without being detected.
trophies.whenMissed: Being detected ends the attempt — leave and retry the robbery from the start.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: From the description: rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each vault counts only if you get away clean afterward, so plan the escape before the robbery — a fast car and a route out of the Wanted Level. The five vaults do not need to be done in one run; each completed robbery-and-escape adds one to the count.
steps: Rob a Bank Vault, then escape clean.
Repeat at four more vaults — 5 in total.
trophies.whenMissed: Each vault counts only on a clean escape; a failed escape means that vault must be robbed again.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: From the description: rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find one on the road in free roam, stop it, take the money, and get away clean — the escape is part of the trophy, so do not stop fighting the Wanted Level until it clears.
steps: Find an Armored Truck in free roam and rob it.
Escape until your Wanted Level clears.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: From the description: explore all of Leonida — the kit's starter records 52 areas. Visit every named area on the map and the trophy pops when the last one registers. Pair it with the WAiNK It and vehicle-discovery trophies, since all three reward the same exploring.
steps: Travel through every area of Leonida until each registers as explored.
Reach all 52 areas.

steps: Find an Illegal Operation for one gang and rob it.
Repeat for every gang — one operation per gang, 9 in total.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: From the description: “Choices made (for better or worse)” — this is about the choices you make while playing, and the tracker counts them (the kit's starter records a count of 500). Make choices as you play — story choices, partner choices, open-world decisions — and the count climbs. Warning: if the count is tied to choices that cannot be undone, a single playthrough may not reach 500, so do not rush past every choice screen; one fan guide treats choice trophies as the reason to keep a manual save before the final mission. The 500 figure is from the trackers, not the description, so treat it as reported, not confirmed.
steps: Make choices whenever the game offers them, in story and free roam.
Keep a manual save before the final mission, as a precaution.
Reach the tracked count of choices.
trophies.whenMissed: Choices may not be undoable — keep saves before big decisions so you can revisit them.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: From the description — only the line “Second time's the charm”: this trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt at something, after a first failure. steps: If an attempt at an activity fails, try the same thing again right away.
Succeed on the second attempt.
trophies.whenMissed: It is about a second try — a first failure is part of the unlock, so do not reload an old save to erase a failure.

steps: Get in a vehicle with a target nearby on foot.
Land a melee hit on them from the moving vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: From the description: earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are cash you pick up from robberies and heists that cannot be spent directly — take them to your contacts to launder them, and the earnings count toward $250,000. It is a long grind that builds on the robbery trophies, so launder after every score.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: From the description: spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — clothes, weapons, food, vehicles and more — and the total is cumulative across the whole game, so it builds naturally as you play. If it has not popped by the end of the story, top it up with a big purchase.
steps: Spend money in shops as you play.
Reach $100,000 spent in total across all shops.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: From the description: purchase all garage properties — the kit's starter records 8 of them. Garages are properties you buy to store vehicles; buy every one on the map and the trophy pops with the last. You will need the money first, so pair this with the laundering and shop-spending trophies.
steps: Earn enough money to buy properties.
Purchase all 8 garage properties.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: From the description: register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles across Leonida, register each one in the app, and stop at 10 — the count is tracked for you. It pairs naturally with discovering 100 vehicles, so register the best ones you find while exploring.
steps: Find a vehicle and register it to the Scooter Bros app.
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
